# Editorial policies
As part of Nature Portfolio, _Communications Physics_ follows common policies as detailed via the menu on the left that our authors and prospective authors must follow.
In particular, when you submit a manuscript to _Communications Physics_ its content must not significantly overlap with any other papers from you or your co-authors’ groups that are under consideration or in press at other journals, with the exception of conference abstracts. We do, however, support the posting of preprints.
If you submit a related manuscript to any other journals while the submission to _Communications Physics_ is under consideration, you must send us a copy of the related manuscript and details of its progress towards publication. Nature Portfolio journals take publication conduct seriously. We reserve the right to decline publication of a paper even after it has been accepted if it becomes apparent that there are serious problems with the scientific content or violations of our publishing policies.
